CustomField.label: Apex Parameters (JSON)
CustomField.description: Optional JSON parameters passed to the class named in "Apex Class". Must be valid JSON; invalid JSON makes the check report that it cannot run (reason INVALID_APEX_PARAMETERS). These are per-check parameters, not org-wide settings. Leave blank if the class needs none.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. Valid JSON passed to your Apex class, e.g. {"threshold": 5}. Leave blank if the class needs no parameters.
